edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.population: adults exposed to chlorinated drinking water
edges.mechanism: This edge is mechanistically plausible in both directions because context changes the dominant pathway, which helps explain why the literature is mixed rather than cleanly positive or negative.
edges.summary: For colorectal cancer, the most useful starting point is the 2026 AlHussaini meta analysis in Pharmaceutics. It found that chlorinated disinfection by-products produces mixed findings across studies, and the follow-on evidence is broadly consistent even when absolute benefit or harm is modest.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
